main.description: One player's result for one island of Sunfarming (dame.is/experimenting/sunfarming): how many island days it took to get the island off its diesel generator. Lives on the PLAYER's repo and points at the island's board through `subject`, so backlink indexers (Constellation et al.) can gather everyone's results without a central database. One result per person per board: the record key is the board's key, so posting again replaces the result that was there. Nothing verifies it; it is what the player's own game said.

subject.description: The board this result belongs to: at://<host did>/is.dame.sunfarming.island/<key>, where <key> is the island's id, or today-YYYY-MM-DD for the daily island. A name to link to, not a record: nothing is stored at that address.

island.description: The island's id, e.g. tern, pines, today.

date.description: For the daily island, the UTC day it was the island of: YYYY-MM-DD.

days.description: How many island days it took. Fewer is better.
